messages.content: The King and Prince contacted me about balcony repairs during our first two nights. Before I answer, find out exactly where the full-stay partial-ocean-view room is and what it includes compared with taking a standard room and moving later.

The full-stay alternative is a Partial Ocean View King on the third floor of the south wing. It has one king bed, a furnished balcony with an angled ocean view, mini-refrigerator, and the same beach access and resort amenities. It is farther from the main lobby than your currently assigned category, but the repair work is not adjacent to it.

The other option puts you in a Standard King without an ocean view or balcony for September 12-14. You would need to check out of that room by 11:00 a.m. on the 14th, leave your luggage with the bell desk, and move to a Partial Ocean View King after 4:00 p.m. The hotel would handle the luggage transfer.
So the south-wing room is ours for all seven nights, with no move, and it still has a king and a usable balcony? Is there any change to the dates, beach access, deposit, or total?

Correct. It is one south-wing Partial Ocean View King for all seven nights, September 12-19, with a king bed and a furnished balcony. Direct beach access remains open. The deposit stays $340.58, the balance remains $2,288.48, and the complete total remains $2,629.06. The hotel is waiving any room-category difference because of the repair issue.
That is better than packing up midway through the stay. Accept the south-wing room for the full stay. Do not cancel the reservation or create another one.
I accepted the full-stay south-wing room under the existing reservation. No new reservation was created, and confirmation KPB-761284 remains active.
Please have them send an updated written confirmation showing the room, the same dates, and the unchanged total.

The updated confirmation has been issued for KPB-761284. It now shows one south-wing Partial Ocean View King with furnished balcony for two adults, September 12-19, 2026. The total remains $2,629.06, with $340.58 paid and $2,288.48 due at the property. It also notes that no room move is required, beach access is unchanged, and the original cancellation deadline of September 5 at 4:00 p.m. Eastern still applies.
